name: Voltane
tagline: The charging network your scooter fleet stops complaining about.
positioning: Usage-based charging infrastructure and uptime telemetry for enterprise micro-mobility operators managing thousands of e-bikes and scooters.

hero.h1: Dead batteries don't file support tickets. Your riders do.
hero.sub: Voltane meters every kilowatt across your scooter and e-bike fleet, kills swap-team guesswork, and bills you only for the juice that actually moved a wheel.

features.title: Per-Watt Metering
features.description: We count every kilowatt-hour down to the individual dock, so your finance team stops arguing with your ops team about the electricity bill.

features.title: Uptime You Can Cite
features.description: Live dock health and 99.95% availability SLAs with receipts. Export the raw telemetry when procurement inevitably asks.

features.title: Swap Route Autopilot
features.description: We tell your street team which 40 vehicles to grab before they hit dead, ranked by charge deficit and rider demand. No more scavenger hunts.

features.title: Fleet-Wide Firmware
features.description: Push charging profiles to 12,000 docks at once. Battery chemistry changed mid-contract? Reconfigure without a truck roll.

features.title: Grid-Aware Throttling
features.description: Charge hard on cheap off-peak power, back off when the utility spikes. Your energy spend drops without anyone touching a dashboard.

features.title: Audit-Grade Ledger
features.description: Every charge session timestamped, signed, and immutable. When the city audits your emissions claims, hand them a file, not an apology.

testimonials.quote: We were losing 18% of our fleet to overnight battery death. Voltane's swap routing clawed that back in three weeks. I stopped getting 6am calls from the depot.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramanathan

testimonials.quote: Usage billing meant I could finally attribute charging cost per vehicle per city. My board asked for that metric for two years. Now it's a dropdown.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: The telemetry export saved our municipal contract renewal. The city wanted proof of uptime and we handed them a signed ledger the same afternoon.
testimonials.name: Elena Vasquez
